sources.title: Metascientific replication project with the advanced meta-experimental protocol of the transparent psi project procedures for testing the precognitive effect claimed by Bem
limitations: Tests a specific Bem-style precognition paradigm rather than every psi claim.
One opposite-direction anomaly replicated once but did not replicate in the third study.
Failure to replicate the target effect does not prove that every form of anomalous cognition is impossible.

sources.title: A neuroscientific model of near-death experiences
limitations: A synthesis and explanatory model, not a decisive prospective test of the full model.
The model is contested and must be reviewed with published criticism and anomalous-case literature.
A neurophysiological account of NDE features would not by itself prove or disprove post-mortem continuation.

sources.title: Near-Death Experiences: A Bibliometric and Systematic Review of Published Literature From 1977 to 2025
limitations: Maps the published field and its themes; it does not adjudicate the ontology of NDEs.
Scopus-indexed literature and bibliometric structure are not equivalent to independent evidential confirmation.
The review reports that no consensus exists on NDE origin or nature.

sources.title: Prevalence of Near-Death Experiences (NDE) in Patients with Refractory Cardiac Arrest Treated with Conventional and Extracorporeal Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation
limitations: Small pilot cohort with only 12 ECPR respondents.
The numerical ECPR difference was not statistically significant.
Reported NDE symptoms do not establish when experience occurred or whether consciousness continued beyond brain function.

sources.title: An exploratory study of breathwork-induced altered states of consciousness in experienced practitioners: the airways to alteration (A2A) trial
limitations: Exploratory study in experienced practitioners; generalisability is limited.
Self-reported psychedelic-like effects do not establish equivalence with drug-induced states.
Phenomenological overlap does not establish a metaphysical or nonlocal mechanism.

claims.text: Across three high-powered studies, the preregistered target precognition effect was not reliably replicated; an opposite-direction anomaly replicated once and then failed to replicate.
claims.uncertainty: The result constrains this paradigm and demonstrates stronger psi-research methods; it neither confirms precognition nor disproves every psi hypothesis.

claims.text: The NEPTUNE review organizes neurophysiological and psychological processes into a testable explanatory model for common NDE features.
claims.uncertainty: The model remains contested and does not resolve whether all NDE reports are fully explained by brain processes.

claims.text: A systematic and bibliometric review identified 775 NDE publications through April 2025 and found continued interdisciplinary growth without consensus on origin or nature.
claims.uncertainty: Publication volume and thematic convergence do not establish the truth of survival or neurobiological models.

claims.text: In a 44-person follow-up cohort of refractory cardiac-arrest survivors, 15 reported at least one NDE symptom; the numerical difference between conventional CPR and ECPR groups was not statistically significant.
claims.uncertainty: The small pilot does not establish a treatment effect, experiential timing, mechanism or post-mortem continuity.

claims.text: In an exploratory controlled study, high-ventilation breathwork was associated with stronger acute psychedelic-like effects than body-scan meditation and with self-reported insight and behavioural change.
claims.uncertainty: The exploratory findings require replication and do not establish equivalence with psychedelic states or any metaphysical interpretation.

required_follow_up: Retrieve and verify the peer-reviewed Greyson and Pehlivanova critique of NEPTUNE before treating the model comparison as balanced.
Review full texts and supplementary materials before any canonical evidence decision.
Check study registrations, corrections, retractions, conflicts of interest and accessible data or code.
Map only to canonical Big Question IDs; planned BQ003-BQ009 remain review horizons, not canonical assignments.
Keep discovery journalism outside the primary evidence layer.

batch_conclusion.statement: The candidates materially improve methods, field mapping and testable model comparison. The strongest movement is methodological rather than ontological; no candidate establishes psi, post-mortem continuation, a complete neurobiological account, or a metaphysical interpretation of altered states.
